title: Half-Earth proposal

definition.text: E. O. Wilson's 2016 proposal that half of the Earth's surface be set aside as a human-free natural reserve to preserve biodiversity.

facts.text: The name 'Half-Earth' was coined for the idea by Tony Hiss; Wilson's book of that name (2016) closes a trilogy.
A Science reviewer questioned whether it was realistic, since in 2015 only 15% of land and 2.8% of marine areas were protected.
Reviewers called it more an aspirational goal than a plan, noting it gives no detail on territories, funding mechanisms or agreements, or on whether people in reserves would be relocated.

contested_note: Reviewers split on whether the target is realistic or politically workable.
